redesigned_interfaces: Mode Selection Page (BR and CS casual maps merged into single entrances for multi-selection matchmaking)
Daily/Weekly Missions page (includes Daily Chest and Free Pass progress)
Match Results page (displays mission progress and EP badges)

gloo_wall_smart_throw.single_tap: Instantly places Gloo Wall directly in front of player
gloo_wall_smart_throw.press_and_hold: Allows precision targeting and releases to confirm placement

ui_and_hud_enhancements.minimap_pinning: Teammates outside standard minimap view scope are pinned at minimap edges to indicate direction

qol_and_system_optimizations.favorite_character_system: Pin favorite characters to top of Characters page and Equip Skills page

replay_system.perspective_toggle: Supports switching between First-Person and Third-Person views
replay_system.match_highlights: Automatic generation based on performance with background music toggle

qol_and_system_optimizations.auto_pickup: Ground loot list ordered strictly according to user Auto-Pickup priority settings

social_and_lobby.party_muting: Mute/unmute individual teammates in lobby or custom rooms
social_and_lobby.match_join_requests: Send join request/whisper when accepting friend booking while in squad

visual_and_audio_fx.gold_acquisition: Special animated visual effect on Gold increase
visual_and_audio_fx.skill_icon_fx: Enhanced visual status indicators for active passive skills and A124 silence status
